Vibb One talks to your server over https only when its certificate comes from Let\'s Encrypt or ZeroSSL. If it now comes from another issuer: put the server back on one of those, or set Server URL to http:// and the server\'s Tailscale IP - the tailnet connection works at once - and turn the check off on the phone\'s page on the admin site if the server stays with the new issuer. Or scan the phone\'s setup code on the admin site again (Scan setup QR).
This server\'s tailnet address: %1$s - set it as Server URL if the phone refuses the server\'s certificate.

Turns off kiosk mode, the time rules and app restrictions for 2 hours (calls stay limited to the allowed contacts), then they come back on by themselves. Needs the device PIN, and isn\'t available when no PIN is set on the server. The parent sees on the server that it\'s on. Emergency use only, e.g. if an update causes a problem.
